tts_hint_windows_sapi: Uses voices already installed in Windows. No external download required. A local pronunciation lexicon can be applied before reading aloud.
tts_hint_vibevoice: Requires the local VibeVoice wrapper. Voices from app_data/tts/vibevoice_openai/models/voices are detected as well; if they appear only as local files, restart the wrapper once. Additional official presets are downloaded automatically during VibeVoice install/update. The “TTS model” field is only relevant for this backend and can usually stay on “tts-1-hd”.

assistant_loading_switched: Switching to model "{model}". Ollama may need a moment to load it before the first tokens arrive.
model_changed_hint: Model changed to "{model}". The next answer may take a moment while Ollama loads it.
tts_setup_info: This assistant bundles VibeVoice install/update. It checks the status, skips FFmpeg when it is already available, downloads the wrapper, sets it up as far as possible, and automatically downloads the additional official voice presets. Important: the actual model download only begins once the wrapper can run successfully.

tts_lexicon_tooltip: Apply a local JSON lexicon to cleaned read-aloud text before synthesis.
read_all_include_names_label: Speak speaker names during Read All
auto_answer_settings_hint: Edit extra automatic reply lines and topic words for gentle topic shifts in ELIZA mode.
auto_answer_editor_info: The JSON file is loaded directly from the app folder. Use “phrases” for extra reply lines per language and “topic_words” for gentle topic shifts in ELIZA mode.
empty_auto_answer_text: The JSON file must not be empty.
tts_model_tooltip: Relevant only for VibeVoice/OpenAI-compatible TTS backends. In most cases you can leave this at “tts-1-hd”.
tts_setup_ready_to_start: VibeVoice installation / update completed. You can now start the VibeVoice server.
composer_state_waiting: LLM is responding … waiting for first tokens.
tts_setup_start_failed: VibeVoice server did not become ready in time.
strip_emojis_tooltip: Removes emojis and simple emoticons from the spoken text before TTS is generated.
chat_max_tokens_tooltip: Limits the LLM reply length. Smaller values can make long auto-answer loops more stable.
auto_answer_rounds_tooltip: Limits how many times auto answer may reply in a row. 0 means unlimited.
context_limit_tooltip: Only the last N messages are sent to the model. This can make longer auto-answer conversations more stable.
auto_answer_limit_reached: Auto-answer limit reached. Continue manually or increase the limit in settings.
auto_answer_short_prompt_dialog_title: Additional prompt for short auto-answer replies
auto_answer_short_prompt_dialog_info: This additional prompt is appended invisibly to the LLM input: for the first user message of a chat and once again for the next user message after an automatic continuation chat. It applies to the currently selected interface language: {language}.
rollover_carry_messages_label: Recent dialog entries for follow-up chat
rollover_carry_messages_tooltip: How many of the latest chat entries should be carried into an automatic follow-up chat. If the context would still be too large, older entries are trimmed automatically.
code_blocks_saved_status: {count} code block(s) were additionally saved in the generated_code subfolder.
context_retry_status: Context limit detected. The app will continue automatically with a follow-up chat …
chat_rollover_trimmed_message: A follow-up chat was opened. Only as many recent messages as possible were carried over automatically so the context can continue stably.
debug_trace_enabled_tooltip: Writes an additional JSONL debug file in app_data/debug_logs with chat flow, estimated token values, request data, rollover events, and the active settings. This file can later be shared for troubleshooting.
settings_profile_hint: Load or save configurations, including the system prompt and extra prompt settings.
save_settings_profile_failed_text:
The configuration could not be saved.

{error}
load_settings_profile_failed_text:
The configuration could not be loaded.

{error}
load_settings_profile_invalid_text: The file does not contain a JSON object with settings.
load_settings_profile_done_text:
The configuration was loaded into the dialog. It becomes active after clicking Save.

auto_thinking_for_code_requests_label: Automatically switch to Thinking mode when code should be created
auto_thinking_for_code_requests_tooltip: When enabled, compatible models automatically use Thinking for detected code requests, and the prompt additionally insists on actually outputting the code in a fenced Markdown code block.
auto_answer_question_replies_settings_hi: Edit short reactions for cases where the LLM asks a question.
auto_answer_question_replies_editor_info: The JSON file is loaded directly from the app folder. Under “replies” you can store short reactions per language that are used when the LLM asks a question. Optionally, these replies can also be included in the normal auto-answer pool.
auto_answer_use_question_replies_for_all: Also allow question-reply list in normal auto-answer replies
When enabled, answers from auto_answer_question_replies.json may appear not only for questions but also in the normal auto-answer pool. For actual questions this list is still preferred.
empty_question_replies_text: The JSON file must not be empty.
allow_consecutive_auto_answer_dataset_re: When disabled, direct repeats of the same entries from auto_answer_phrases.json or auto_answer_question_replies.json are avoided in the next auto-answer turn whenever possible.
auto_answer_timer_failed: Auto-answer was stopped due to an internal error.
